column2:
cabinet(n.)櫥櫃、內閣
(無詞性變化)
kitchen cabinet 廚房櫥櫃
cabinet member 內閣閣員
She keeps the medicine in a locked cabinet.
(她把藥放在上鎖的櫃子裡。)
The new cabinet members were introduced to the public.
(新任內閣閣員向大眾亮相。)

calculate(v.)計算、估計
calculation(n.)計算
calculator(n.)計算機
calculate the cost 計算成本
carefully calculated 精心計算的
Can you calculate how much we spent on the trip?
(你能算出我們這趟旅行花了多少錢嗎？)
Scientists calculated the distance to the star.
(科學家計算出到那顆星星的距離。)

calculation(n.)計算、估算
calculate(v.)計算
make a calculation 進行計算
rough calculation 粗略估算
According to my calculation, we need 20 more chairs.
(根據我的計算，我們還需要二十張椅子。)
One small mistake in the calculation led to the wrong answer.
(計算中一個小錯誤導致了錯誤的答案。)

calorie(n.)卡路里、熱量
(無詞性變化)
low-calorie 低熱量的
burn calories 燃燒熱量
Running is a great way to burn calories.
(跑步是燃燒熱量的好方法。)
Bubble tea is high in calories and sugar.
(珍珠奶茶的熱量和糖分都很高。)

campaign(n./v.)運動、活動、競選、發起運動
campaigner(n.)活動人士
election campaign 競選活動
campaign against 發起反對……的運動
The school started a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
(學校發起一項減少塑膠垃圾的活動。)
The candidates are busy with their election campaigns.
(候選人們忙於競選活動。)

candidate(n.)候選人、應徵者
candidacy(n.)候選資格
presidential candidate 總統候選人
strong candidate 有力人選
There are three candidates for class leader.
(班長有三位候選人。)
The company interviewed five candidates for the job.
(公司為這份工作面試了五位應徵者。)

cane(n.)手杖、藤條、(植物的)莖
(無詞性變化)
walking cane 手杖
sugar cane 甘蔗
My grandfather walks with a cane.
(我爺爺拄著手杖走路。)
Sugar cane was once an important crop in southern Taiwan.
(甘蔗曾是台灣南部的重要作物。)

canoe(n./v.)獨木舟、划獨木舟
canoeing(n.)划獨木舟運動
paddle a canoe 划獨木舟
go canoeing 去划獨木舟
We paddled a canoe across the lake.
(我們划著獨木舟橫越湖面。)
They went canoeing on the river last weekend.
(他們上週末去河上划獨木舟。)

capacity(n.)容量、能力、身分
capable(adj.)有能力的
seating capacity 座位容量
full capacity 滿載
The stadium has a capacity of 50,000 people.
(這座體育場可容納五萬人。)
She has a great capacity for learning languages.
(她學習語言的能力很強。)

capital(n.)首都、資本、大寫字母、capitalism(n.)資本主義
capitalist(n.)資本家
capital city 首都
capital letter 大寫字母
Taipei is the capital of Taiwan.
(台北是台灣的首都。)
Capitalism is based on private ownership and free markets.
(資本主義以私有制和自由市場為基礎。)

capitalist(n.)資本家、資本主義者
capitalism(n.)資本主義
capitalistic(adj.)資本主義的
capitalist society 資本主義社會
capitalist economy 資本主義經濟
The factory was owned by a wealthy capitalist.
(這間工廠為一位富有的資本家所有。)
The United States has a capitalist economy.
(美國實行資本主義經濟。)

cargo(n.)貨物
(無詞性變化)
cargo ship 貨輪
cargo plane 貨機
The cargo ship carried thousands of containers.
(這艘貨輪載著數千個貨櫃。)
The workers unloaded the cargo at the port.
(工人們在港口卸貨。)

carrier(n.)運送者、運輸公司、帶原者
carry(v.)攜帶、運送
mail carrier 郵差
aircraft carrier 航空母艦
The mail carrier delivers letters every morning.
(郵差每天早上送信。)
Mosquitoes can be carriers of disease.
(蚊子可能是疾病的傳播者。)

carve(v.)雕刻、切(肉)
carving(n.)雕刻品
carve wood 刻木頭
carve out 開創
The artist carved a beautiful bird out of wood.
(這位藝術家用木頭雕出一隻美麗的鳥。)
Dad carved the turkey at Thanksgiving dinner.
(爸爸在感恩節晚餐時切火雞。)

catalogue(n./v.)目錄、編目錄
catalog(n.)目錄(美式拼法)
product catalogue 產品目錄
library catalogue 圖書館館藏目錄
She looked through the catalogue to choose a new sofa.
(她翻閱目錄挑選新沙發。)
The librarian catalogued all the new books.
(圖書館員把所有新書編入目錄。)

category(n.)類別、種類
categorize(v.)分類
fall into a category 屬於某一類
age category 年齡組別
The books are arranged by category.
(這些書按類別排列。)
She won first prize in the under-18 category.
(她在十八歲以下組獲得第一名。)

cease(v./n.)停止、終止
ceaseless(adj.)不停的
cease fire 停火
without cease 不停地
The factory ceased production last year.
(這間工廠去年停止生產。)
It never ceases to amaze me how fast children learn.
(孩子學得那麼快，總是讓我驚訝。)

celebration(n.)慶祝、慶典
celebrate(v.)慶祝
in celebration of 為了慶祝
birthday celebration 生日慶祝
The whole town joined the New Year celebration.
(全鎮的人都參加了新年慶典。)
They held a party in celebration of their victory.
(他們舉辦派對慶祝勝利。)

chamber(n.)房間、議院、腔室
(無詞性變化)
chamber music 室內樂
chamber of commerce 商會
The heart has four chambers.
(心臟有四個腔室。)
We enjoyed an evening of chamber music.
(我們享受了一晚的室內樂。)

championship(n.)冠軍賽、錦標賽、冠軍頭銜
champion(n.)冠軍
win the championship 贏得冠軍
world championship 世界錦標賽
Our school team won the basketball championship.
(我們校隊贏得了籃球冠軍。)
She will compete in the world championship next month.
(她下個月將參加世界錦標賽。)

characteristic(n./adj.)特徵、特性、特有的
character(n.)性格、角色
characterize(v.)以……為特徵
main characteristic 主要特徵
characteristic of 為……所特有
Patience is one of the characteristics of a good teacher.
(耐心是好老師的特質之一。)
This dish has the characteristic flavor of Tainan food.
(這道菜有台南料理特有的風味。)

charity(n.)慈善、慈善機構、施捨
charitable(adj.)慈善的
charity event 慈善活動
donate to charity 捐給慈善機構
The money from the concert will go to charity.
(音樂會的收入將捐給慈善機構。)
She works for a charity that helps poor children.
(她在一個幫助貧童的慈善機構工作。)

chemistry(n.)化學、(人與人之間的)默契
chemical(adj./n.)化學的、化學物質
chemist(n.)化學家
chemistry class 化學課
good chemistry 默契很好
We did an interesting experiment in chemistry class.
(我們在化學課上做了一個有趣的實驗。)
The two actors have great chemistry on screen.
(這兩位演員在螢幕上很有默契。)

cherish(v.)愛惜、重視、懷念
(無詞性變化)
cherish the memory 懷念回憶
cherish a dream 懷抱夢想
I will always cherish the time we spent together.
(我會永遠記得並重視我們在一起的時光。)
We should cherish our friendships.
(我們應該愛惜友誼。)

chew(v./n.)咀嚼、嚼
chewy(adj.)有嚼勁的
chewing gum 口香糖
chew on 咀嚼、仔細思考
Chew your food well before you swallow.
(吞下去之前要把食物嚼爛。)
Chewing gum is not allowed in class.
(上課時不准嚼口香糖。)

choke(v./n.)窒息、噎住、阻塞
(無詞性變化)
choke on 被……噎到
choke back tears 強忍淚水
The child almost choked on a piece of candy.
(那個孩子差點被一顆糖噎到。)
She choked back her tears and smiled.
(她強忍淚水露出微笑。)

chorus(n.)合唱團、副歌、齊聲
choral(adj.)合唱的
school chorus 學校合唱團
in chorus 齊聲地
She sings in the school chorus.
(她參加學校合唱團。)
Everyone sang along during the chorus.
(大家在副歌時一起合唱。)

circular(adj.)圓形的、循環的
circle(n.)圓圈
circular shape 圓形
circular economy 循環經濟
The table has a circular shape.
(這張桌子是圓形的。)
A circular economy aims to reduce waste.
(循環經濟的目標是減少浪費。)

circulate(v.)循環、流通、傳播
circulation(n.)循環、發行量
circulate news 散布消息
blood circulates 血液循環
Blood circulates through the body.
(血液在全身循環。)
Rumors about the new teacher circulated quickly.
(關於新老師的傳言很快地傳開了。)

circulation(n.)循環、流通、發行量
circulate(v.)循環、流通
blood circulation 血液循環
in circulation 在流通中
Exercise improves blood circulation.
(運動能促進血液循環。)
The magazine has a circulation of 100,000 copies.
(這本雜誌的發行量是十萬本。)

circumstance(n.)情況、環境
(無詞性變化)
under no circumstances 絕不
under the circumstances 在這種情況下
Under no circumstances should you open the door.
(無論如何你都不能開門。)
He did his best under difficult circumstances.
(他在艱困的環境下盡了全力。)

civilian(adj./n.)平民的、平民
civil(adj.)公民的、民用的
civilian life 平民生活
innocent civilians 無辜百姓
Many civilians were hurt in the war.
(許多平民在戰爭中受傷。)
After the army, he returned to civilian life.
(退伍後，他回歸平民生活。)

civilization(n.)文明
civilize(v.)使文明化
civilized(adj.)文明的
ancient civilization 古文明
modern civilization 現代文明
Egypt is home to one of the oldest civilizations.
(埃及是最古老文明之一的發源地。)
Writing played a key role in human civilization.
(文字在人類文明中扮演關鍵角色。)

clarify(v.)澄清、闡明
clarification(n.)澄清、說明
clarity(n.)清晰
clarify a point 說明某一點
clarify the situation 澄清情況
Could you clarify what you mean?
(你能說明一下你的意思嗎？)
The teacher clarified the rules before the test.
(老師在考試前說明規則。)

clash(n./v.)衝突、撞擊聲、(顏色)不搭配
(無詞性變化)
clash with 與……衝突
culture clash 文化衝突
Police clashed with protesters in the street.
(警方在街頭與抗議者發生衝突。)
Your red shirt clashes with your pink pants.
(你的紅色上衣和粉紅色褲子不搭。)

classification(n.)分類、類別
classify(v.)分類
classification system 分類系統
film classification 電影分級
The classification of animals helps scientists study them.
(動物分類有助於科學家研究牠們。)
This film has a classification of PG-13.
(這部電影是輔導十三級。)

classify(v.)分類、將……歸類
classification(n.)分類
classified(adj.)機密的、分類的
classify into 分成……類
classified information 機密資訊
Books in the library are classified by subject.
(圖書館的書依主題分類。)
Scientists classify whales as mammals.
(科學家把鯨魚歸類為哺乳類。)

claw(n./v.)爪子、螯、用爪抓
(無詞性變化)
sharp claws 尖銳的爪子
claw machine 夾娃娃機
The cat scratched me with its sharp claws.
(那隻貓用利爪抓傷了我。)
He spent all his coins on the claw machine.
(他把所有硬幣都花在夾娃娃機上。)

cliff(n.)懸崖、峭壁
(無詞性變化)
cliff edge 懸崖邊
steep cliff 陡峭的懸崖
The Qingshui Cliff in Hualien is very famous.
(花蓮的清水斷崖非常有名。)
Don't stand too close to the edge of the cliff.
(別站得太靠近懸崖邊。)

clumsy(adj.)笨拙的
clumsily(adv.)笨拙地
clumsiness(n.)笨拙
clumsy movement 笨拙的動作
clumsy attempt 拙劣的嘗試
I'm so clumsy that I broke another cup.
(我真笨手笨腳，又打破了一個杯子。)
The puppy's clumsy steps made us laugh.
(小狗笨拙的步伐讓我們發笑。)

coarse(adj.)粗糙的、粗俗的
coarsely(adv.)粗糙地
coarse sand 粗沙
coarse language 粗俗的話
The fabric feels coarse against my skin.
(這塊布料貼在皮膚上感覺很粗糙。)
Please don't use coarse language in class.
(上課時請不要講粗話。)

code(n./v.)密碼、代碼、規範、編碼
coding(n.)程式設計
dress code 服裝規定
QR code 行動條碼
Scan the QR code to pay.
(掃描 QR 碼來付款。)
Students are learning to write computer code.
(學生們正在學習寫程式碼。)

collapse(n./v.)倒塌、崩潰、昏倒
(無詞性變化)
collapse of 某物的崩潰
on the verge of collapse 瀕臨崩潰
The old bridge collapsed during the earthquake.
(那座舊橋在地震中倒塌了。)
He collapsed from heat after running the marathon.
(他跑完馬拉松後中暑昏倒。)

colleague(n.)同事
(無詞性變化)
former colleague 前同事
work colleague 工作上的同事
My mother gets along well with her colleagues.
(我媽媽和她的同事們相處融洽。)
He discussed the plan with a colleague.
(他和一位同事討論了這項計畫。)

combination(n.)結合、組合、密碼組合
combine(v.)結合
in combination with 與……結合
perfect combination 完美組合
Success is a combination of talent and hard work.
(成功是天分與努力的結合。)
I forgot the combination to my lock.
(我忘了我的鎖的密碼。)

comedy(n.)喜劇
comedian(n.)喜劇演員
comic(adj.)喜劇的
romantic comedy 浪漫喜劇
comedy show 喜劇節目
We watched a funny comedy last night.
(我們昨晚看了一部好笑的喜劇。)
Romantic comedies are popular among teenagers.
(浪漫喜劇在青少年之間很受歡迎。)

commander(n.)指揮官、司令
command(v./n.)命令、指揮
military commander 軍事指揮官
commander in chief 總司令
The commander ordered his soldiers to retreat.
(指揮官命令他的士兵撤退。)
The president is the commander in chief of the army.
(總統是三軍統帥。)

comment(n./v.)評論、意見、發表意見
commentary(n.)評論、實況報導
commentator(n.)評論員
make a comment 發表意見
no comment 無可奉告
The teacher wrote some helpful comments on my essay.
(老師在我的作文上寫了一些有幫助的評語。)
He refused to comment on the news.
(他拒絕對這則新聞發表評論。)

commerce(n.)商業、貿易
commercial(adj./n.)商業的、廣告
e-commerce 電子商務
international commerce 國際貿易
E-commerce has changed the way people shop.
(電子商務改變了人們購物的方式。)
The city has long been a center of commerce.
(這座城市長久以來一直是商業中心。)

commit(v.)犯(罪)、承諾、投入
commitment(n.)承諾、投入
committed(adj.)盡心盡力的
commit a crime 犯罪
commit oneself to 致力於
The man was arrested for committing a crime.
(那名男子因犯罪而被捕。)
She committed herself to helping homeless animals.
(她致力於幫助流浪動物。)

communication(n.)溝通、通訊
communicate(v.)溝通
communicative(adj.)溝通的
communication skills 溝通技巧
means of communication 通訊方式
Good communication is the key to a happy family.
(良好的溝通是幸福家庭的關鍵。)
Smartphones are the main means of communication today.
(智慧型手機是現今主要的通訊工具。)

community(n.)社區、社群、共同體
(無詞性變化)
local community 當地社區
community service 社區服務
Students are required to do community service.
(學生必須做社區服務。)
The online community shares tips about learning English.
(這個網路社群分享學英文的訣竅。)

companion(n.)同伴、伴侶
companionship(n.)友誼、陪伴
traveling companion 旅伴
constant companion 形影不離的同伴
My dog has been my faithful companion for ten years.
(我的狗十年來一直是我忠實的夥伴。)
She was a great traveling companion.
(她是很棒的旅伴。)

competition(n.)競爭、比賽
compete(v.)競爭
competitive(adj.)競爭的
fierce competition 激烈的競爭
enter a competition 參加比賽
She won first place in the speech competition.
(她在演講比賽中得到第一名。)
There is fierce competition among smartphone companies.
(手機公司之間競爭激烈。)

competitive(adj.)競爭的、好勝的、有競爭力的
compete(v.)競爭
competitiveness(n.)競爭力
competitive price 有競爭力的價格
highly competitive 競爭激烈的
The job market is highly competitive.
(就業市場競爭非常激烈。)
He is very competitive and hates to lose.
(他非常好勝，很討厭輸。)

competitor(n.)競爭者、參賽者
compete(v.)競爭
competition(n.)比賽
main competitor 主要競爭對手
strong competitor 強勁對手
More than 200 competitors took part in the race.
(超過兩百名參賽者參加了這場賽跑。)
The company is losing customers to its competitors.
(這家公司的客戶正被競爭對手搶走。)

complicate(v.)使複雜化
complicated(adj.)複雜的
complication(n.)複雜化、併發症
complicate matters 使事情複雜
further complicate 進一步複雜化
Don't complicate things by changing the plan again.
(別再改計畫把事情弄複雜了。)
The bad weather complicated the rescue work.
(惡劣的天氣使救援工作更加複雜。)

compose(v.)組成、作曲、撰寫、使鎮定
composition(n.)作文、作品
composer(n.)作曲家
be composed of 由……組成
compose oneself 使自己鎮定
The team is composed of ten members.
(這支隊伍由十名成員組成。)
Mozart composed his first piece at the age of five.
(莫札特五歲時就創作了他的第一首曲子。)

composer(n.)作曲家
compose(v.)作曲
composition(n.)樂曲
famous composer 著名作曲家
film composer 電影配樂家
Beethoven is one of the greatest composers in history.
(貝多芬是史上最偉大的作曲家之一。)
The film composer wrote music for many popular movies.
(這位配樂家為許多熱門電影寫了音樂。)

composition(n.)作文、作品、組成
compose(v.)組成、作曲
English composition 英文作文
chemical composition 化學成分
We have to write an English composition this week.
(我們這週要寫一篇英文作文。)
Scientists studied the composition of the rock.
(科學家研究了這塊岩石的組成成分。)

concentrate(v.)專心、集中
concentration(n.)專心、集中
concentrate on 專注於
concentrate one's efforts 集中心力
I can't concentrate on my homework with the TV on.
(電視開著我沒辦法專心寫功課。)
Most of the population is concentrated in big cities.
(大部分人口集中在大城市。)

concentration(n.)專注力、集中、濃度
concentrate(v.)專心
lose concentration 分心
high concentration 高濃度
Lack of sleep can affect your concentration.
(睡眠不足會影響你的專注力。)
The air has a high concentration of dust today.
(今天空氣中的灰塵濃度很高。)

concept(n.)概念、觀念
conceptual(adj.)概念的
basic concept 基本概念

harsh critic 嚴厲的批評者
The film critic gave the movie five stars.
(影評人給了這部電影五顆星。)
He is one of the government's harshest critics.
(他是政府最嚴厲的批評者之一。)

critical(adj.)批評的、關鍵的、危急的
critic(n.)評論家
critically(adv.)批判地、危急地
critical thinking 批判性思考
in critical condition 情況危急
Critical thinking is an important skill for students.
(批判性思考是學生重要的能力。)
The injured man is in critical condition.
(那名傷者情況危急。)

criticism(n.)批評、評論
criticize(v.)批評
critic(n.)評論家
accept criticism 接受批評
constructive criticism 建設性的批評
He can't take any criticism.
(他完全無法接受批評。)
The new policy faced strong criticism from parents.
(新政策遭到家長強烈批評。)

criticize(v.)批評、評論
criticism(n.)批評
critic(n.)評論家
criticize sb. for 因……批評某人
be widely criticized 受到廣泛批評
Don't criticize others for their mistakes.
(不要因別人犯錯就批評他們。)
The movie was criticized for being too violent.
(這部電影因過於暴力而遭批評。)

cruelty(n.)殘忍、殘酷行為
cruel(adj.)殘忍的
animal cruelty 虐待動物
act of cruelty 殘忍的行為
Animal cruelty is against the law.
(虐待動物是違法的。)
The story shows the cruelty of war.
(這個故事呈現了戰爭的殘酷。)

crunchy(adj.)酥脆的、脆的
crunch(n./v.)嘎吱聲、嘎吱地咬嚼
crunchy snack 酥脆的零食
crunchy vegetables 爽脆的蔬菜
I love crunchy peanut butter.
(我很愛顆粒花生醬。)
These cookies are sweet and crunchy.
(這些餅乾又甜又脆。)

crush(n./v.)壓碎、壓垮、迷戀
crushing(adj.)壓倒性的
have a crush on 迷戀某人
crush ice 碎冰
He has a crush on a girl in his class.
(他暗戀班上的一個女生。)
The car was crushed by a falling tree.
(那輛車被倒下的樹壓扁了。)

cube(n./v.)立方體、塊、切丁
cubic(adj.)立方的
ice cube 冰塊
sugar cube 方糖
She put some ice cubes in her drink.
(她在飲料裡加了幾塊冰塊。)
Cube the potatoes before cooking them.
(烹煮前先把馬鈴薯切丁。)

cue(n./v.)暗示、提示、給……提示
(無詞性變化)
on cue 恰好在這時
take one's cue from 學某人的樣
The actor waited for his cue to enter the stage.
(那名演員等待上台的提示。)
Right on cue, the bus arrived.
(就在這時，公車正好到了。)

cunning(adj./n.)狡猾的、狡詐
cunningly(adv.)狡猾地
cunning plan 狡猾的計畫
as cunning as a fox 像狐狸一樣狡猾
The fox in the story is very cunning.
(故事裡的狐狸非常狡猾。)
He used cunning to win the game.
(他耍詐贏了這場遊戲。)

curiosity(n.)好奇心
curious(adj.)好奇的
out of curiosity 出於好奇
satisfy one's curiosity 滿足好奇心
Out of curiosity, I opened the box.
(出於好奇，我打開了箱子。)
Curiosity is the starting point of learning.
(好奇心是學習的起點。)

curl(n./v.)捲髮、捲曲、使捲曲
curly(adj.)捲曲的
curl up 蜷縮
curl one's hair 燙捲頭髮
The cat curled up on the sofa.
(貓蜷縮在沙發上。)
She has beautiful blond curls.
(她有一頭漂亮的金色捲髮。)

curse(n./v.)詛咒、咒罵、禍害
cursed(adj.)被詛咒的
put a curse on 對……下咒
curse and swear 咒罵
The witch put a curse on the princess.
(女巫對公主下了詛咒。)
He cursed when he missed the train.
(他錯過火車時咒罵了一聲。)

curve(n./v.)曲線、彎道、使彎曲
curved(adj.)彎曲的
sharp curve 急彎
learning curve 學習曲線
Slow down before the sharp curve.
(過急彎前要減速。)
The road curves along the coast.
(這條路沿著海岸蜿蜒。)

cushion(n./v.)墊子、坐墊、減輕(衝擊)
(無詞性變化)
sofa cushion 沙發靠墊
cushion the impact 減輕衝擊
She sat on a soft cushion.
(她坐在一個柔軟的墊子上。)
The soft grass cushioned his fall.
(柔軟的草地減輕了他跌倒的衝擊。)
